description: README update, requirements.txt annotation, and final regression verification. This feature is independent of FEAT-002 (it only reads existing files and the plan) but depends on FEAT-001 (the new API endpoints must exist before the README can accurately document them). Run last.
steps: Step 1 — Update backend/requirements.txt: add a comment block at the top noting that sqlite3, hashlib, csv, io, contextlib, and uuid are Python stdlib and require no pip install. Do not change any package versions or add new packages.

Step 2 — Extend README.md at wifi-lan-security-analyzer/README.md: (a) In the Module 1 table, note that data is now persisted to SQLite. (b) Replace the 'Module 2 Preview' section (which describes coming features) with a 'Module 2 — Security Analysis Engine (implemented)' section containing: DB location (backend/data/analyzer.db), schema version table, six entity tables listed by name. (c) Add an 'Approval Workflow' subsection: three states (pending_review, approved, revoked), how to approve from the Network Devices page. (d) Add a 'Security Rules' subsection: table with Rule ID, Severity, Trigger for all four rules (NEW_DEVICE_001, SENSITIVE_PORT_001, POLICY_PORT_001, INCOMPLETE_SCAN_001). (e) Add 'Scoring' subsection: formula (start 100, high=-15, medium=-8, low=-3, provisional flag). (f) Add 'New API Endpoints (Module 2)' table listing: GET /api/scans/{scan_id}, GET /api/scans/compare, GET /api/devices/{device_id}, PATCH /api/devices/{device_id}/approval, GET /api/findings, GET /api/reports/{scan_id}, GET /api/reports/{scan_id}/csv. (g) Update the folder structure tree to include: backend/app/services/inventory_service.py, risk_engine.py, score_service.py, report_service.py; backend/app/api/findings.py, reports.py; backend/app/schemas/device.py, findings.py, report.py; backend/data/analyzer.db (runtime). (h) Keep all existing Module 1 documentation unchanged.
Step 3 — Run full backend test suite as final regression check: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v. Record the result in this FEAT's findings field.
acceptance_criteria: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v — all tests pass
README.md contains a 'Module 2' section with API endpoint table
README.md contains the four security rule IDs
README.md folder structure includes the new service files
requirements.txt has stdlib comment and no new packages
